latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editing AI for Android — fast AI-powered edits with zero setup.

- Upload raw video footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) and describe your desired edits in natural language.
- Edit, trim, add transitions, and export directly to 1080p MP4 via cloud-based GPU processing.
- No installation or complex setup required; automatic session management and token handling.
- Supports common video, audio, and image formats; export jobs typically finish in under 90 seconds.
- Check credits, monitor timeline state, and handle errors with user-friendly feedback.
- Built for Android creators who want rapid edits ready for social media.
